scale.3: Meets minimum based on current hypothesis
scale.4: Strong expected fit, evidence still to collect

criteria_descriptions.functionality_source_coverage: Critical source and object coverage, incremental/delete semantics, schema drift, backfill
criteria_descriptions.scalability: Ability to meet freshness and throughput as usage grows
criteria_descriptions.security_compliance: IAM, secrets, audit, data processing terms, region and security gates
criteria_descriptions.integration: Warehouse, orchestration, secrets, CI/CD and lineage integration
criteria_descriptions.operability: Retries, replay, upgrades, alerting, incident triage and on-call burden
criteria_descriptions.ecosystem: Available skills, integrations, hiring pool and community
criteria_descriptions.support: Contractual response, escalation and reference quality
criteria_descriptions.lock_in_portability: Data/config export, destination neutrality, tested migration path
criteria_descriptions.price_predictability: Usage definition, quote, caps/alerts, renewal and overage terms

evidence_status: All scores are illustrative hypotheses for teaching, not measured or verified vendor-specific results. Every candidate hard-gate status is NOT_ASSESSED. Replace with dated documentation, POC measurements, references and written commercial quotes before approval.
hard_gates: Critical source/object coverage and update/delete semantics
Acceptable export, termination and deletion terms

candidate_labels.fivetran_managed: Fivetran managed ingestion (illustrative hypothesis; verify connector/plan fit)
candidate_labels.airbyte_self_managed: Airbyte self-managed (illustrative hypothesis; verify deployment/connector fit)
candidate_labels.custom_dlt: Custom dlt-based ingestion (illustrative hypothesis; implementation owned by team)

candidate_rationale.fivetran_managed: Hypothesis only: expect lower routine connector operations and broad standard-source coverage, offset by usage-billing uncertainty and higher switching costs. Validate with source inventory, POC, quote, export test, references, and security/legal review.
candidate_rationale.airbyte_self_managed: Hypothesis only: expect greater deployment control and potentially predictable licence economics, offset by team-owned upgrades, scaling, security, support, and incident response. Validate exact Core connectors/version, staffing, capacity, licence, and recovery.
candidate_rationale.custom_dlt: Hypothesis only: expect source-specific control and code ownership, offset by custom connector build effort and ongoing maintenance/on-call. Measure engineering time, correctness, failure recovery, security, and exit work in the POC.
